title: Gemini 3.5 Flash: Benchmarks & Deep Analysis
author: Benchmark Lab
excerpt: We put Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash through our rigorous testing suite. From 1 million token context retrieval to agentic execution latency, here is the full analysis of Google's latest speed demon.
body:
Google's 'Flash' line of models has historically focused on speed and cost-effectiveness. With the release of **Gemini 3.5 Flash**, DeepMind attempts to close the reasoning capability gap with their 'Pro' models while maintaining high throughput and low latency.

### Comprehensive Benchmark Analysis

Our evaluation suite puts Gemini 3.5 Flash head-to-head against both previous generation Flash models and frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI:

| Benchmark | Category | Gemini 3.5 Flash | Gemini 3 Flash | Gemini 3.1 Pro | Claude Sonnet 4.6 | Claude Opus 4.7 | GPT-5.5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Terminal-bench 2.1 (Agentic terminal coding) | Coding | 76.2% | 58.0% | 70.3% | — | 66.1% | 78.2% |
| SWE-Bench Pro (Public) | Coding | 55.1% | 49.6% | 54.2% | — | 64.3% | 58.6% |
| MCP Atlas (Multi-step workflows) | Agentic | 83.6% | 62.0% | 78.2% | 69.5% | 79.1% | 75.3% |
| Toolathlon (Real-world tool use) | Agentic | 56.5% | 49.4% | — | — | — | 55.6% |
| OSWorld-Verified (Agentic computer use) | UI Control | 78.4% | 65.1% | 76.2% | 72.5% | 78.0% | 78.7% |
| Finance Agent v2 (Financial analysis) | Expert tasks | 57.9% | 42.6% | 43.0% | 51.0% | 51.5% | 51.8% |
| GDPval-AA (Elo) | Expert tasks | 1656 | 1204 | 1314 | 1676 | 1753 | 1769 |
| CharXiv Reasoning (Chart synthesis) | Multimodal | 84.2% | 80.3% | 83.3% | 72.4% | 82.1% | 84.1% |
| MMMU-Pro (Multimodal understanding) | Multimodal | 83.6% | 81.2% | 80.5% | 74.5% | 75.2% | 81.2% |
| Blueprint-Bench 2 (Spatial reasoning) | Multimodal | 33.6% | 0.0% | 26.5% | 6.7% | 24.5% | 36.2% |
| MRCR v2 128k (Long context) | Long context | 77.3% | 67.2% | 84.9% | 84.9% | 59.3% | 94.8% |
| MRCR v2 1M (Long context) | Long context | 26.6% | 22.1% | 26.3% | — | — | — |
| Humanity’s Last Exam (Academic reasoning) | Reasoning | 40.2% | 33.7% | 44.4% | 33.2% | 46.9% | 41.4% |
| ARC-AGI-2 (Abstract reasoning) | Reasoning | 72.1% | 33.6% | 77.1% | 58.3% | 75.8% | 84.6% |

### Industry Partner Evaluations

Early integration reviews from enterprise partners highlight the real-world efficiency gains of the new model:

> “Gemini's newest flash model advances the frontier for intelligence per dollar. It performs 42% better than Flash 3 on our long range, multi-turn cyber benchmark, while achieving a 68% improvement in token efficiency. This makes it an excellent choice for defenders seeking to scale horizontally.” — David Slater, Chief Architect, Armadin

> “Gemini 3.5 Flash beat Gemini 3 Flash by 19.6% on Box’s enterprise work evaluation set, which we designed to reflect the kinds of real-world, multi-step tasks our customers perform daily with the Box Agent. Our Life Sciences customers can use Gemini 3.5 Flash to extract data and make calculations with 96.4% greater accuracy, while Financial Services firms can build reports with 46.7% greater accuracy.” — Ben Kus, Chief Technology Officer, Box

> “Gemini 3.5 Flash delivers coding and reasoning quality close to Gemini Pro, while preserving the speed and cost profile that make Flash ideal for real-time developer workflows. The new model also improves low reasoning coding performance by 10–20% compared to the previous Flash generation.” — Nick Frolov, Head of Product, Junie, JetBrains

### Model Information & Specifications

- **Input Modalities**: Text, Image, Video, Audio, and PDF
- **Output Modalities**: Text
- **Token Tiers**: 1M Input tokens, 64k Output tokens limit
- **Tool Integrations**: Function calling, Structured output, Google Search tool, and native Code execution
- **Availability**: Gemini App, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Google AI Studio, Google Antigravity, and Android Studio.

### The Verdict
Gemini 3.5 Flash represents a massive performance step-change. It effectively narrows the reasoning quality gap to Gemini Pro while keeping the speed and cost profile that developers expect for scalable, real-time agentic workflows.
